what.text: This page follows Venezuelans in Mexico whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 64160 people in this group in Mexico, 1.1% of all Venezuelans in it.
The largest numbers of Venezuelan refugees live in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Venezuela, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data run from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR has counted this group only since 2018, when the figure was 42104.
It reached its highest point, 81847, at the end of 2020 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mexico.
These are year-end totals for Mexico only, and the group is never added to refugees.
